company info.description: CleanBelval provides professional cleaning services for homes, offices, commercial spaces, and public areas in Luxembourg.
company info.mission: Our goal is to provide reliable, eco-friendly, and high-quality cleaning solutions.

faq.Do you provide services outside of Belva: Yes, we provide services in all major cities of Grand Duchy of Luxembourg!
faq.Do you provide cleaning products?: Yes, cleaning products are included in all packages, however the type of the product depends on the package you purchase.
faq.Do you clean commercial spaces?: Yes, we provide services for homes, offices, and commercial spaces.
faq.Do you clean offices?: Yes, we provide services for homes, offices, and commercial spaces.
faq.Do you clean homes?: Yes, we provide services for homes, offices, and commercial spaces.
faq.What is the cancellation policy?: Customers should call us directly or contact us through the form on the main page 24 hours before the appointment to cancel and get a full refund!
faq.What do you offer?: Our experienced team provides reliable cleaning services for homes, offices, and commercial spaces. We focus on quality, attention to detail, and customer satisfaction in every project.
faq.Is your company eco-friendly?: We prioritize environmentally responsible cleaning methods by using sustainable products and practices that help protect both your space and the environment.
faq.Do you clean windows?: Yes, window cleaning is included in our Standard and Premium packages.
faq.Do you clean bathrooms?: Yes, bathroom cleaning is included in our Basic package and above.
faq.Do you remove waste?: Yes, waste removal is included in our Basic package.
faq.Do you offer discounts?: Unfortunately, we have fixed prices and we do not offer discounts
faq.Why should I choose CleanBelval?: CleanBelval provides reliable, professional, and eco-friendly cleaning solutions with flexible scheduling and customer-focused service.
faq.How can I book a cleaning service?: You can do so by purchasing a package on our website and filling in the form including the credit card credentials
faq.How long does a cleaning service take?: The duration depends on the size of the property and the selected package.
faq.What are your working hours/time?: We are open monday to saturday. However, monday to friday we work from 08:00 AM until 18:00 PM. On Saturdays, we are available from 10:00 AM to 14:00 PM. On sundays we are closed!
faq.What happens if I am not satisfied with: Please contact us and we will work to resolve the issue.
faq.Can I change my appointment time?: You can contact us through phone number or contact form and we will sort it out for you!

greeting: Hello, how can we help you today?
